contracts.contract: URL normalization supplies default identity; extended method/payload identity and always-enqueue are separate policies. Native ECDEV has an explicit HTTP GET site policy; exact normalization parity is pending.
uniqueKey caches avoid duplicate additions; backend owns queue persistence. Deferred storage transactions remain outside ECDEV scope.
backend fetch delegates request locking; in-progress requests are not fetched a second time.
handled state is delegated to backend and cached; completed requests remain deduplicated.
reclaim returns a request to queue; forefront is delegated to the backend.
adapter delegates processing timeout to native backend; this is not evidence of native backend internals.
native lock extension returns whether the backend still holds the request.
adapter flushes native persistence on teardown; crash semantics require independent backend review.

donor_tests.symbol: a reclaimed request is fetched again
requests added and persisted are restored
